text:
Alice K: quick sync — we need to decide the wire format for tool execution + what metadata must be preserved across the agent->tool->result path. customers asking for deterministic replay and better telemetry.
Sam R: +1, we should set minimal required fields and an optional metadata bag.
Priya S: important: backwards compatibility with existing function-call-compatible models. Customers want clear migration path.
Marc L: proposed minimal envelope: 
```json
{
  "tool": "<name>",
  "version": "v1",
  "input": { ... },
  "meta": { "request_id": "<uuid>", "origin": "chat", "schema": "toolwire-v1" }
}
```
Alice K: ok that looks fine. question: do we force base64 for binary outputs or leave to content-type?
Sam R: prefer content-type + optional base64 field for binaries. easier for clients. note: must record size bytes in meta for routing/cost.
Priya S: telemetry: we need three events: invoke.request, invoke.start, invoke.complete with status (ok, partial, error) and error_code enums. these should include token counts and latency.
Marc L: agree — add a compact error envelope: 
```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "code": "TOOL_TIMEOUT",
  "message": "timed out after 10s",
  "debug": "optional"
}
```
Alice K: rollout constraints: we can't break hosted APIs. launch gating: SDKs updated, server-side v1/v2 acceptor layer, e2e tests, and 3 pilot customers signed up.
Sam R: timeline? product needs to lock scope by next Wed. engineering estimate: 2 sprints for wire + telemetry + SDKs.
Priya S: customer asks we should track schema version in meta and surface deprecation warnings in responses. also allow model-side function_call passthrough so models can still emit earlier shape.
Marc L: decision options: (A) strict envelope v1 w/ migration helpers (B) permissive pass-through + server normalizer. I prefer B to reduce customer breakage.
Alice K: lean toward B too — add a server normalizer and a strict mode toggle for dedicated/private customers.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of "tool-wire-normalizer" scheduled for 2025-08-12 03:00 UTC if CI passes. :rocket:
Sam R: action items: Marc -> implement normalizer + error mapping; Priya -> telemetry event spec + sampling policy; Alice -> customer comms + pilot invites; me -> SDK wrappers (py/ts).
Priya S: launch criteria checklist suggestion: 1) SDKs published, 2) normalizer in prod w/ canary, 3) telemetry anchors in console, 4) 3 pilot integrations, 5) docs & migration guide.
Alice K: +1. I'll draft migration guide and schedule a 30m sync after scope lock.
Sam R: noted. tagging @marc @priya for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
Marc L: I'll drop a PR with initial normalizer rules and an example mapping table. expect first pass EOD tomorrow.
Alice K: thanks everyone — closing thread, will post the scope doc here when ready.
